name: class1forever.github.io
//: Cloudflare: check = build + runtime + API; dev:local uses local demo KV and passphrase demo, never remote credentials. EdgeOne: build:edgeone emits isolated static/function inputs; check:edgeone uses built-bundle Node HTTP fixtures, not real Makers runtime. check:dual runs both. data:publish is offline prepare/verify/verify-readback only. Production deploy/data/secrets/DNS remain separate approval gates; see docs/dual-deployment-runbook.md.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:runtime && npm run test:api
scripts.check:edgeone: npm run build:edgeone && npm run test:api:edgeone && node scripts/check-edgeone-runtime.mjs && node --test tests/edgeone-adapter.test.mjs tests/data-release.test.mjs tests/font-subsets.test.mjs
scripts.check:dual:assets: node --test tests/dual-assets.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-dual-assets.mjs && node build.js --artifacts-only && node scripts/build-edgeone.mjs --artifacts-only
scripts.check:dual: npm run check && npm run check:edgeone && npm run test:geodns && npm run test:session && npm run check:dual:assets && npm run test:production
